parentRuntime.scope: Actual parent executable/version and zlib backend identity; not a complete formal pin of every OS/standard-library binary

meta.scope: Authoritative inventory/integrity acceptance; endpoint availability and aggregate replay completion are distinct. New matched study only; prior project outcomes were known before this follow-up.

primary.scope: Process-level samples; paired sums are approximate, not a continuous/private peak. Gzip bytes differ from complete dense canonical raw bytes.

resources.scope: Independent parent samples owned replay child and itself every50ms, sequential approximate paired working sets; missed short peaks remain possible. Primary and replay resource phases remain separate.

auditSummary.scope: Inventory acceptance is distinct from numerical availability. Independently authored direct-scan replay from zero checks all available endpoint bytes, every stored transcript block, complete graphs/windows/curves. Shared V8/Math.exp/crypto/zlib backend and inherited audited saved payoff/mask premises; no old economic re-enumeration, no cross-runtime proof. Every-round block hashes are compared, not authenticated original per-round logs. Whole-study full replay requires all24 full horizons and all48 checkpoints. No inferential interval or convergence/equilibrium claim.
